name: trustpilot-reviews-api
title: Trustpilot Reviews API - Reviews, Ratings & Company Replies
description: Trustpilot hands an anonymous reader 200 reviews and a login page, so most scrapers sell a capped list without saying so. This one reads the real page in a live browser, walks every star filter, adds company replies, and never charges for a blocked page.

meta.memoryJustification: A real Chromium window under Xvfb needs about 700 MB of RSS for one tab; the measured peak of the browser plus python is ~900 MB, so the run starts at 1024.
